items.q: Is sporting skill purely something you're born with?
items.correct: No — skills are learned and improved through practice and feedback.
items.misconception: Yes, skill is innate and can't be trained.
items.random_wrong: Practice has no effect on performance.
items.why: Talent helps, but skill develops through quality practice, coaching and feedback.

items.q: Does mental preparation affect sporting performance?
items.correct: Yes — focus, arousal control and confidence influence performance.
items.why: Sports psychology (e.g. managing arousal and anxiety) is a key part of performance.
